content: The function FrIf_SetAbsoluteTimer shall wrap This API service of the FlexRay Interface wraps the FlexRay Driver API function Fr_SetAbsoluteTimer() by: 1. Translating (based on static FrIf module configuration) the FlexRay CC index Fr If_CtrlIdx into a tuple (FlexRay Driver | Driver-specific CC index Fr_CtrlIdx). 2. Setting parameters 3. Fr_AbsTimerIdx to FrIf_AbsTimerIdx 4. Fr_Cycle to FrIf_Cycle 5. Fr_Offset to FrIf_Offset 6. Calling Fr_SetAbsoluteTimer() of the determined FlexRay Driver module with the parameters determined as described above.
